name: WhatSThis_9
short_caption: The robot lifts its right hand slightly forward in a questioning manner, then opens both hands palms-up to express uncertainty or inquiry before returning to rest.
movement_description: The robot starts by lifting its right hand slightly forward with a loose grip as if presenting or questioning. It then sweeps both arms outward with open, palms-up hands while tilting its head slightly, conveying a 'what is this?' gesture. Finally, it smoothly retracts both arms down and brings its head back to the central, neutral posture.
safety_notes: The robot extends both arms forward and slightly outward; ensure a clear safety zone of about 0.5 meters in front of the chest.
